# AOGI — Agent Manifest

## What
AI Orchestration Governance Infrastructure: a Policy-as-Code control plane for
governing AI agents — OWASP ASI, EU AI Act, GDPR/CCPA/Colorado CPA, COPPA.
Public sandbox for the Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit (vendored at `toolkit/`).

## Start here (agents)
- `AGENTS.md` — repo map, lanes, standing rules
- `ai-docs/INDEX.md` — capability docs + `@touchpoint` map
- `CONTRIBUTING.md` — contribution workflow

## Layout
- `aogi/` — governance engine (hub, middleware, dashboard, crypto, sandbox)
- `policies/` — OPA/Rego hard-gates
- `tests/` — governance + integration tests
- `blueprints/` — roadmaps & system design
- `toolkit/` — Microsoft Agent Governance Toolkit (submodule fork)

## Signals
- Agent-Context: governance, axo, asi, compliance, policy-as-code
- Standard: AFDocs / AXO
